title: Earth-CMB forced unit-sphere trajectories in the authoritative ICRS phase metric

assumptions.kinematic_coupling: tangent projection of fixed Earth/CMB direction

kinematic_model.exact_pull_solution: n(t) = tanh(Omega_E t)c + sech(Omega_E t)b, b dot c = 0
kinematic_model.cost_rate: df_G/dt = sigma Omega_E [c^T G n - (c dot n)(n^T G n)]/f_G
